query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  data,
  cat1 + cat2 + cat9 as totalDia
FROM faturamentos
WHERE data LIKE '2026-05-%'
  AND empresaSlug IN ('barbiero-mascote', 'barbiero-morumbi', 'barbiero-seraphine')
  AND (cat1 + cat2 + cat9) > 0
ORDER BY empresaSlug, data;
